1. The liquid film formed between the U-shaped wire and the slider has two free surfaces.
2. Surface tension acts on both surfaces, so the total upward force is 2 * T * L.
3. The downward force is the weight supported by the film, W = 1.5 x 10^-2 N.
independent_solutions.solver_b:
Downward force is the weight $W = 1.5 \times 10^{-2}\text{ N}$.
Upward force is due to surface tension. A liquid film has two free surfaces.
Upward force $F = 2 \times T \times L$, where $T$ is surface tension and $L = 30\text{ cm} = 0.3\text{ m}$.
